convert_amount.description: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another at ExchangeRate-API's latest rate, or at its rate on a past date, which needs a paid plan (Pro or above). Comes back with the converted amount, the rate used and the conversion as a sentence.
convert_amount.name: convert_amount

parameters.description: How much to convert, in the From currency, such as 100 or 19.99. A negative amount, such as a refund, converts too.
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: The currency to convert from, as a three-letter code such as USD. List currencies lists every code ExchangeRate-API supports.
parameters.name: from_currency

parameters.description: The currency to convert into, as a three-letter code such as EUR.
parameters.name: to_currency

parameters.description: The day whose rate to use, back to 1990-01-01. Leave blank for the latest rate. A date needs a paid ExchangeRate-API plan (Pro or above).
parameters.name: on_date

amount.description: The amount that was converted, in the From currency

converted_amount.description: The amount in the To currency, unrounded: round it for display, or use Summary

date.description: The day the rate is for, YYYY-MM-DD: the date asked for, or the day ExchangeRate-API last updated its latest rates (UTC)

from_currency.description: The From currency's three-letter code, e.g. USD

next_update_at.description: When it will next update them, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

rate.description: The rate used: how much of the To currency one unit of the From currency buys

summary.description: The conversion as a sentence, ready to show someone, e.g. 100 USD = 85.12 EUR

to_currency.description: The To currency's three-letter code, e.g. EUR

updated_at.description: When ExchangeRate-API last updated its latest rates, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

get_all_rates.description: Get the exchange rates from one currency to every currency ExchangeRate-API supports, or to just the ones you list, in one step. The latest rates, or those on a past date back to 1990, which needs a paid plan (Pro or above).
get_all_rates.display_name: Get every rate for a currency
get_all_rates.display_str_template: Get every exchange rate from {base_currency} with ExchangeRate-API.
get_all_rates.name: get_all_rates

parameters.description: The currency every rate is from: each rate is how much of another currency one unit of it buys. A three-letter code such as USD; leave blank for the US dollar.
parameters.name: base_currency

parameters.description: Only the rates to these currencies, as three-letter codes separated by commas or spaces, such as EUR, GBP, JPY, in the order to list them. Leave blank for every currency.
parameters.name: currencies

parameters.description: The day to get the rates for, back to 1990-01-01. Leave blank for the latest rates. A date needs a paid ExchangeRate-API plan (Pro or above), and before 2021 has rates for 35 major currencies only.
parameters.name: on_date

base_currency.description: The currency every rate is from, e.g. USD

date.description: The day the rates are for, YYYY-MM-DD: the date asked for, or the day ExchangeRate-API last updated its latest rates (UTC)

next_update_at.description: When it will next update them, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

rates.description: One entry per currency: the base currency first, at 1, then the rest in code order, or in the order they were asked for

currency.description: The currency's three-letter code, e.g. EUR

rate.description: How much of it one unit of the base currency buys

rates_by_currency.description: The same rates keyed by currency code, for looking one up without searching the list

updated_at.description: When ExchangeRate-API last updated its latest rates, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

get_currency_details.description: Get a currency's name, symbol, country and flag, with its latest exchange rate from another currency. Needs a paid ExchangeRate-API plan (Pro or above).
get_currency_details.display_str_template: Get the details of {currency} from ExchangeRate-API.
get_currency_details.name: get_currency_details

parameters.description: The currency to describe, as a three-letter code such as JPY.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The currency to give the exchange rate from, as a three-letter code such as USD. Leave blank for the US dollar.
parameters.name: base_currency

base_currency.description: The currency the rate is from, e.g. USD

country.description: The country or region that uses it, e.g. Japan or European Union

country_code.description: That country's or region's two-letter code, e.g. JP

currency.description: The currency's three-letter code, e.g. JPY

flag_url.description: A link to a picture of its flag

next_update_at.description: When it will next update them, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

rate.description: How much of the currency one unit of the base currency buys, at the latest rate

symbol.description: The symbol it is written with, e.g. ¥

updated_at.description: When ExchangeRate-API last updated its latest rates, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

get_exchange_rate.description: Get the exchange rate between two currencies, the latest one or the one on a past date, which needs a paid plan (Pro or above). Comes back with the rate both ways round, so there is no need to divide one into the other.
get_exchange_rate.display_str_template: Get the {from_currency} to {to_currency} exchange rate from ExchangeRate-API.
get_exchange_rate.name: get_exchange_rate

parameters.description: The currency to convert from, as a three-letter code such as USD. List currencies lists every code ExchangeRate-API supports.
parameters.name: from_currency

parameters.description: The currency to convert into, as a three-letter code such as EUR.
parameters.name: to_currency

parameters.description: The day whose rate to use, back to 1990-01-01. Leave blank for the latest rate. A date needs a paid ExchangeRate-API plan (Pro or above).
parameters.name: on_date

date.description: The day the rate is for, YYYY-MM-DD: the date asked for, or the day ExchangeRate-API last updated its latest rates (UTC)

from_currency.description: The From currency's three-letter code, e.g. USD

inverse_rate.description: The rate the other way round: how much of the From currency one unit of the To currency buys

next_update_at.description: When it will next update them, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

rate.description: How much of the To currency one unit of the From currency buys

summary.description: The rate as a sentence, e.g. 1 USD = 0.8512 EUR

to_currency.description: The To currency's three-letter code, e.g. EUR

updated_at.description: When ExchangeRate-API last updated its latest rates, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Empty for a rate on a past date

get_request_quota.description: Get how many requests your ExchangeRate-API plan allows a month, how many are left and when they renew. The check counts as a request itself, and its figures can lag 5 to 60 minutes behind.
get_request_quota.name: get_request_quota

next_refresh_date.description: The next date the requests renew, YYYY-MM-DD, worked out from the renewal day

percent_used.description: The share used, as a percentage, e.g. 14.6 for 14.6%

plan_quota.description: How many requests the plan allows a month

refresh_day_of_month.description: The day of the month the requests renew: the day the plan started

requests_remaining.description: How many are left this month. The count lags the requests by 5 to 60 minutes

requests_used.description: How many have been used this month

list_currencies.description: List every currency ExchangeRate-API has rates for, each with its three-letter code and name, in code order.
list_currencies.name: list_currencies

codes.description: Just the codes, e.g. to check whether one is supported before using it

currencies.description: Every supported currency, in code order

description: Convert currencies with ExchangeRate-API: convert an amount between any two of over 160 currencies, get the exchange rate between two currencies or every rate from one, at the latest rates or on a past date back to 1990, get a currency's name, symbol, country and flag, and check your plan's request quota. Needs a free ExchangeRate-API key; past dates and currency details need a paid plan.
